en.s: The three year Carolingian Civil War culminated in the decisive Battle of Fontenoy-en-Puisaye, also called the Battle of Fontenoy, fought at Fontenoy, near Auxerre, on the 25 June 841. The war was the contention over the territorial inheritances —the division of the unified lands of Charlemagne's Carolingian Empire between his grandsons, the three surviving sons of Louis the Pious. Despite provisions by Louis the Pious, war broke out between his sons and nephews. It was a defeat for the allied forces of Lothair I of Italy and Pepin II of Aquitaine and a victory for Charles the Bald and Louis the German.

zh.s: 持续三年的加洛林内战最终在841年6月25日的丰特努瓦昂普伊赛战役中迎来决定性一战，战场位于欧塞尔附近。战争起因是争夺领土继承权：查理曼统一的加洛林帝国领地要在虔诚者路易的三名在世儿子之间分割。尽管虔诚者路易曾作出安排，他的儿子和侄子仍爆发战争。意大利的洛泰尔一世和阿基坦的丕平二世率领联军战败，秃头查理和日耳曼人路易则取得胜利。

en.s: The Battle of the Gulf (Icelandic: Flóabardagi) was a naval battle on 25 June 1244 in Iceland's Húnaflói Bay, during the Age of the Sturlungs civil war. The conflicting parties were the followers of Þórður kakali Sighvatsson and those of Kolbeinn ungi Arnórsson. Þórður's men were from the Westfjords of Iceland, while Kolbeinn's were northerners. The primary weapons were rocks hurled between boats.

zh.s: 海湾战役（冰岛语：Flóabardagi）是1244年6月25日在冰岛胡纳湾发生的一场海战，属于斯图隆家族内战。交战双方分别是索尔杜尔·卡卡利·西格瓦特松的追随者，以及科尔贝因·乌恩吉·阿尔诺松的追随者。索尔杜尔一方来自冰岛西峡湾，科尔贝因一方则来自北部。双方主要用石块互相投掷作战。

en.s: The Battle of Acre took place in 1258 off the port of Acre, between the fleets of the Republic of Genoa and the Republic of Venice. Mounting tensions between the traders of the two cities had resulted in the outbreak of open warfare between the two ("War of Saint Sabas"), with the Venetians blockading the Genoese in their quarter.

zh.s: 1258年，热那亚共和国舰队与威尼斯共和国舰队在阿卡港外交战。两城商人间的紧张关系不断加剧，最终引发公开冲突，即圣萨巴战争。威尼斯舰队封锁了热那亚人所在的城区。

en.s: The Battle of Brańsk — In 1264, the Duke of Krakow, Boleslaw V the Chaste organized an expedition against Yotvingia, who were allied with Shvarn, the Duke of the Kingdom of Galicia–Volhynia. The immediate cause of the expedition was the Yotvingian raid into Polish territories in 1264 during which they ravished and plundered the country. On 23 June 1264 the two armies met near Brańsk.

zh.s: 1264年，克拉科夫公爵“贞洁者”博莱斯瓦夫五世组织远征军进攻约特温吉亚。当时约特温吉亚与加利西亚—沃里尼亚王国公爵什瓦尔恩结盟。此次远征的直接起因是约特温吉亚人在1264年袭击波兰领土，劫掠当地。两军于1264年6月23日在布兰斯克附近交战。

en.t: Battle of the Vega of Granada
en.s: The Battle of Sierra Elvira, also called the Disaster of the Vega de Granada, was a battle of the Spanish Reconquista fought near the city of Granada on 25 June 1319 (6 Jumada al-Awwal 719 AH). The battle was fought between the troops of the Emirate of Granada and those of the Kingdom of Castile. The battle resulted in a catastrophic defeat for Castile.

zh.s: 西埃拉埃尔维拉战役又称格拉纳达平原大败，于1319年6月25日（回历719年朱马达·阿瓦尔月6日）在格拉纳达附近爆发，是西班牙收复失地运动期间的一场战斗。交战双方是格拉纳达埃米尔国和卡斯蒂利亚王国军队。卡斯蒂利亚遭遇灾难性失败。

en.s: The Battle of Crotoy was a naval battle which occurred on 25 June 1347 at the mouth of the Somme off the Le Crotoy, when a French fleet of 40 ships gathered in attempted to relieve Calais, where an English army under the command of King Edward III of England was besieging the French town during the Edwardian phase of the Hundred Years' War.

zh.s: 克罗托瓦海战于1347年6月25日在索姆河口、克罗托瓦附近海域爆发。法国舰队集结了40艘船，试图解救正在被英王爱德华三世军队围攻的法国城镇加莱。当时正值百年战争的爱德华战争阶段。

en.s: The Schaffhausen massacre was an anti-Semitic episode in Schaffhausen, in present-day Switzerland, which occurred in 1401. An episode of antisemitism had already occurred in Schaffhausen 52 years prior, when the local Jews were accused of well poisoning and burned alive on 22 February 1349. On this occasion, the Jews were accused of the murder of a four-year-old boy, Konrad Lori from Diessenhofen.

zh.s: 1401年，今瑞士沙夫豪森发生反犹事件，当地犹太人被指控谋杀来自迪森霍芬的四岁男孩康拉德·洛里。52年前，当地也曾发生反犹事件：犹太人被指控投毒污染水井，并于1349年2月22日被活活烧死。

en.s: The Battle of La Roche-l'Abeille occurred on 25 June 1569 between the Catholic forces of King Charles IX of France commanded by the Duke d’Anjou and the Huguenots commanded by the Admiral de Coligny during the "Third War" (1568–1570) of the French Wars of Religion.

zh.s: 拉罗什拉贝耶战役于1569年6月25日爆发，是法国宗教战争第三次战争（1568—1570年）中的一场战斗。法王查理九世的天主教军队由安茹公爵指挥，胡格诺派军队则由科利尼海军上将率领。

en.s: The Battle of Trzciana (also known as Battle of Honigfelde or Battle on the Stuhmer Heide or Battle of Sztum) took place on 25 June 1629 (usually said to be 27th in the New Style calendar) and was one of the battles of the Polish-Swedish War (1626–1629) or Second Swedish-Polish War. The Polish forces were led by Crown Field Hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and imperial troops under Hans Georg von Arnim-Boitzenburg, sent by emperor Ferdinand II to aid Sigismund III, met with troops commanded by Swedish King Gustav II Adolf, who supported the Protestant Lutherans of Germany and northern Europe.

zh.s: 特尔济亚纳战役又称霍尼希费尔德战役、施图梅尔荒原战役或什图姆战役，于1629年6月25日爆发（按新历通常记为6月27日），是波兰—瑞典战争（1626—1629年）或第二次瑞典—波兰战争中的一场战役。波兰军由王室野战盖特曼斯坦尼斯瓦夫·科涅茨波尔斯基率领；神圣罗马帝国皇帝斐迪南二世派遣汉斯·格奥尔格·冯·阿尼姆—博伊岑堡率领帝国军队支援齐格蒙特三世。两军迎战由瑞典国王古斯塔夫二世·阿道夫指挥的瑞典军队；他支持德国和北欧的新教路德宗势力。

en.t: Ottoman forces capture Thodorou during the Cretan War
en.s: On June 25, 1645, Ottoman forces captured the Venetian-held castle on Thodorou, an islet off Crete, during the opening of the Cretan War. Its location is in present-day Greece. Venetian political control at the time does not make the physical site part of Italy.

zh.t: 奥斯曼军队攻占托多鲁岛要塞
zh.s: 1645年6月25日，奥斯曼军队围攻并夺取克里特岛近海托多鲁岛上的要塞。要塞当时由威尼斯共和国控制；岛屿位于今天的希腊。

en.s: The siege of Carlisle occurred during the First English Civil War when the allied forces of the Scottish Covenanters and the English Parliamentarians besieged Carlisle Castle which was held at the time by the English Royalist forces loyal to King Charles I. The siege took place in Carlisle, Cumbria from October 1644 to 25 June 1645.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第一次英国内战期间，苏格兰圣约派和英国议会军联军围攻由效忠查理一世的英国保王党军队控制的卡莱尔城堡。围城战发生在坎布里亚郡卡莱尔，于1644年10月开始，至1645年6月25日结束。

en.s: The Battle of Nowa Woda was an armed struggle between a Lithuanian raiding party led by Herman Ganskopf and the vanguard of the Russian army led by Nikita Odoevsky, which took place on 25 June 1654, and ended with a Polish-Lithuanian victory. 19th-century historians such as Edward Kotłubaj and Ludwik Kubala mistranslated and misidentified the site of the battle as "Nowa Woda"; Igor Babulin (2018) demonstrated that the clash took place at Bogdanowa Okolica or Bogdanov Kholm, a hill about 5 kilometres northeast of Smolensk on the right bank of the Dnieper.

zh.s: 1654年6月25日，赫尔曼·甘斯科普夫率领的立陶宛袭击部队与尼基塔·奥多耶夫斯基率领的俄军先头部队交战，波兰—立陶宛联邦军获胜。19世纪史学家爱德华·科特武巴伊和路德维克·库巴拉误译并误认了战场地点，称其为“新沃达”。伊戈尔·巴布林于2018年指出，交战地点应是博格丹诺瓦奥科利察（又称博格丹诺夫山），位于斯摩棱斯克东北约5公里、第聂伯河右岸。

en.s: The Battle of Rio Nuevo occurred on 25 June 1658 on the island of Jamaica between Spanish forces under Cristóbal Arnaldo Isasi and English forces under governor Edward D'Oyley. In the battle lasting over two days the invading Spanish were routed. It is the largest battle to be fought on Jamaica.

zh.s: 里奥努埃沃战役于1658年6月25日在牙买加岛爆发，交战双方是克里斯托瓦尔·阿纳尔多·伊萨西率领的西班牙军队和总督爱德华·多伊利指挥的英军。战斗持续两天多，入侵的西班牙军队遭到击溃。这是牙买加发生过的规模最大的一场战斗。

en.s: The siege of Douai, which lasted from 22 April 1710 until the capitulation of the garrison under lieutenant-general François Zénobe Philippe Albergotti on 25 June 1710 was part of the Allied campaign of 1710 in the War of the Spanish Succession.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 杜埃围城战是西班牙王位继承战争期间盟军1710年战役的一部分，围城于1710年4月22日开始。守军由中将弗朗索瓦·泽诺布·菲利普·阿尔贝戈蒂指挥，最终于1710年6月25日投降。

en.t: Maria Theresa is crowned as ruler of Hungary in Pressburg
en.s: On June 25, 1741, Maria Theresa was crowned in Pressburg, now Bratislava in Slovakia, as ruler of the Kingdom of Hungary.

zh.t: 玛丽亚·特蕾莎在普雷斯堡加冕为匈牙利君主
zh.s: 1741年6月25日，玛丽亚·特蕾莎在普雷斯堡（今斯洛伐克布拉迪斯拉发）加冕为匈牙利王国君主。

en.t: Virginia ratifies the United States Constitution
en.s: On June 25, 1788, Virginia ratified the United States Constitution, becoming the tenth state to do so.

zh.t: 弗吉尼亚州批准美国宪法
zh.s: 1788年6月25日，弗吉尼亚州批准美国宪法，成为第十个批准宪法的州。

en.s: The Curonian Uprising was a series of battles during the Kościuszko Uprising, fought between the Russian Empire and Polish–Lithuanian insurgents. It took place from 25 June to 12 August 1794, in the Duchy of Courland and Semigallia, and Pilten County. It ended with Russian victory, and retreat of the insurgent forces.

zh.s: 库尔兰起义是柯斯丘什科起义期间俄帝国与波兰—立陶宛起义军之间的一系列战斗，发生于1794年6月25日至8月12日，地点在库尔兰和瑟米加利亚公国及皮尔滕县。最终俄军获胜，起义军撤退。

en.s: On June 25, 1814, a British maritime force landed at Chesconessex Creek, Virginia, to attack an American fort. The British forces, several hundred Royal Marines, Colonial Marines and sailors, landed from Royal Navy vessels Albion, Dragon and Endymion. They were commanded by Lieutenant George Urmston of the Albion. The commander of the first British landing boat, Lieutenant James Scott, had requested permission to attack the fort as the commander of its Virginia militia garrison, Captain John G.

zh.t: 切斯科内塞克斯溪突袭
zh.s: 1814年6月25日，1812年战争期间，英国海军部队在美国弗吉尼亚州切斯科内塞克斯溪登陆，准备袭击当地堡垒。数百名皇家海军陆战队、殖民地海军陆战队员和水手乘“阿尔比恩”号、“龙”号和“恩底弥翁”号登陆，由“阿尔比恩”号的乔治·厄姆斯顿中尉指挥。首批登陆艇指挥官詹姆斯·斯科特中尉曾请求进攻许可，因为弗吉尼亚民兵驻军指挥官约翰·G·乔因斯上尉此前威胁说，若斯科特尝试进攻，就要“把他送下地狱”。

en.s: The Battle of the Lerna Mills was fought on 25 June 1825, in Lerna, Greece between the Egyptian forces of Ibrahim Pasha and Greek forces led by General Yannis Makriyannis, Demetrios Ypsilantis, Andreas Metaxas and Konstantinos Mavromichalis. It was the first Greek success against Ibrahim and saved the city of Nafplio, seat of the government, from capture.

zh.s: 莱尔纳磨坊战役于1825年6月25日在希腊莱尔纳爆发，交战双方是易卜拉欣帕夏率领的埃及军队，以及由扬尼斯·马克里扬尼斯、德米特里奥斯·伊普西兰蒂斯、安德烈亚斯·梅塔克萨斯和康斯坦丁诺斯·马夫罗米哈利斯率领的希腊军队。这是希腊军队首次战胜易卜拉欣，也使政府所在地纳夫普利翁免遭攻占。

en.s: The Battle of Kellogg's Grove is either of two minor battles, or skirmishes, fought during the Black Hawk War in the U.S. state of Illinois, in present-day Stephenson County at and near Kellogg's Grove. In the first skirmish, also known as the Battle of Burr Oak Grove, on June 16, 1832, Illinois militia forces fought against a band of at least 80 Native Americans.
en.n: The Second Battle of Kellogg's Grove occurred on June 25, 1832, after Major John Dement and his men, while camped at Kellogg's Grove on Sunday June 24, learned of a large group of Native Americans nearby.

zh.s: 凯洛格树林战役是发生在美国伊利诺伊州、现今斯蒂芬森县凯洛格树林及附近的两场小规模战斗或冲突的统称。第一场冲突又称伯橡树林战役，于1832年6月16日爆发，伊利诺伊州民兵与至少80名美洲原住民交战。
zh.n: 第二场凯洛格树林战役于1832年6月25日爆发。6月24日星期日，约翰·德门特少校和部下在凯洛格树林扎营时，得知附近有一大群美洲原住民。

en.s: The siege of Cawnpore was a key episode in the Indian Rebellion of 1857. The besieged East India Company forces and civilians in Cawnpore (now Kanpur) were duped into a false assurance of a safe passage to Allahabad by the rebel forces under Nana Sahib. Their evacuation from Cawnpore thus turned into a massacre; most of the men were killed, while women and children were taken to a nearby dwelling known as Bibi Ghar.

zh.s: 1857年6月5日至25日，印度民族起义期间，叛军围困坎普尔的东印度公司军队及平民。被围者随后在所谓安全撤离安排中遭到屠杀，妇女和儿童被带往比比加尔。

en.s: The Battle of Oak Grove, also known as the Battle of French's Field or King's School House, took place on June 25, 1862, in Henrico County, Virginia, the first of the Seven Days Battles (Peninsula Campaign) of the American Civil War. Maj. Gen. George B. McClellan advanced his lines with the objective of bringing Richmond within range of his siege guns. Two Union divisions of the III Corps attacked across the headwaters of White Oak Swamp, but were repulsed by Maj. Gen. Benjamin Huger's Confederate division.

zh.s: 橡树林战役又称弗伦奇田野战役或国王校舍战役，于1862年6月25日在弗吉尼亚州亨里科县爆发，是美国内战七日战役（半岛战役）的第一场战斗。乔治·B·麦克莱伦少将推进防线，试图让攻城炮进入里士满射程。联邦军第三军的两个师穿过白橡沼泽源头发起进攻，但被本杰明·休格少将率领的邦联军师击退。

en.s: The Battle of Staunton River Bridge was an engagement on June 25, 1864, between Union and Confederate forces during Wilson-Kautz Raid of the American Civil War. The battle took place around the Staunton River Bridge, over the Staunton River, in Halifax and Charlotte counties, Virginia.

zh.s: 斯汤顿河桥战役于1864年6月25日爆发，是美国内战威尔逊—考茨骑兵突袭期间联邦军与邦联军的一场交战。战场位于弗吉尼亚州哈利法克斯县和夏洛特县的斯汤顿河桥一带。

en.s: The 1866 Texas gubernatorial election was held on June 25, 1866 to elect the Governor of Texas. Incumbent Governor Andrew J. Hamilton, who had been appointed by President Andrew Johnson, did not run for a full term. The election was won by James W. Throckmorton, who received 80% of the vote.

zh.s: 得克萨斯州于1866年6月25日举行州长选举。时任州长安德鲁·J·汉密尔顿由总统安德鲁·约翰逊任命，此次没有竞选完整任期。詹姆斯·W·索克莫顿以80%的得票率胜出。

en.s: The Battle of the Little Bighorn, known to the Lakota and other Plains Indians as the Battle of the Greasy Grass and commonly referred to as Custer's Last Stand, was an armed engagement between combined forces of the Lakota, Northern Cheyenne, and Arapaho tribes and the 7th Cavalry Regiment of the United States Army. The battle, which occurred June 25–26, 1876, near the Little Bighorn River in eastern Montana Territory, was the most prominent action of the Great Sioux War of 1876. The fight was an overwhelming victory for the Lakota, Northern Cheyenne, and Arapaho, led by several major war leaders, including Crazy Horse and Chief Gall, inspired by the visions of Sitting Bull (Tȟatȟáŋka Íyotake).

zh.s: 小大角战役又称拉科塔人及其他平原印第安人所说的“油腻草地之战”，也常被称为“卡斯特的最后一战”。这场武装冲突于1876年6月25日至26日在蒙大拿领地东部、小大角河附近爆发，交战双方是拉科塔、北夏延和阿拉帕霍族联军，以及美国陆军第七骑兵团。它是1876年大苏族战争中最著名的战斗。拉科塔、北夏延和阿拉帕霍军队取得压倒性胜利，疯马和加尔酋长等人率军作战，坐牛所见的异象也鼓舞了他们。

en.s: The Mogao Caves, also known as the Thousand Buddha Grottoes or Caves of the Thousand Buddhas, form a system of 500 temples 25 km (16 mi) southeast of the center of Dunhuang, an oasis located at a religious and cultural crossroads on the Silk Road, in Gansu province, China.

zh.s: 1900年6月25日，王圆箓在敦煌莫高窟一处洞窟内，循着香烟飘动的气流发现走廊侧面被封住的空间，后来称为藏经洞。

en.s: The 1901 Stratford-on-Avon by-election was a Parliamentary by-election held on 25 June 1901. The constituency returned one Member of Parliament (MP) to the House of Commons of the United Kingdom, elected by the first past the post voting system. en.s: The Canadian federal election of 1968 was held on June 25, 1968, to elect members of the Canadian House of Commons of the 28th Parliament of Canada. The Liberal Party won a majority government under its new leader, Prime Minister Pierre Trudeau. This was the last federal election in which some provinces (specifically Manitoba, Nova Scotia, Quebec and Saskatchewan) had fewer seats they had been allocated in the previous election due to a redistribution. The 1966 census, for example, revealed that Alberta had a population about 50% greater than Saskatchewan's even though both provinces had the same number of seats at the time (17).

zh.s: 加拿大于1968年6月25日举行联邦大选，选出第28届加拿大众议院议员。自由党在新任党魁、总理皮埃尔·特鲁多领导下赢得多数席位。这是最后一次有些省份（曼尼托巴、新斯科舍、魁北克和萨斯喀彻温）因重新划分选区而比上届减少席位的联邦大选。例如，1966年人口普查显示，阿尔伯塔省人口比萨斯喀彻温省多约50%，但当时两省席位数相同，均为17席。

en.s: The 1969 Manitoba general election was held on June 25, 1969 to elect Members of the Legislative Assembly (MLAs) of the Canadian province of Manitoba. en.s: Mozambique, officially the Republic of Mozambique, is a country in Southeast Africa bordered by the Indian Ocean to the east, Tanzania to the north, Malawi and Zambia to the northwest, Zimbabwe to the west, and Eswatini and South Africa to the south and southwest. en.s: The Disgrace of Gijón refers to the 1982 FIFA World Cup football match played between West Germany and Austria at the El Molinón stadium, Gijón, Spain, on 25 June 1982. The match was the last game of the first-round Group 2, with Algeria and Chile having played the day before. With the outcome of that match already decided, a win by one or two goals for West Germany would result in both them and Austria qualifying at the expense of Algeria, who had beaten West Germany in the first game.

zh.s: “希洪之耻”指1982年6月25日在西班牙希洪埃尔莫利农球场举行的一场1982年国际足联世界杯足球赛。比赛双方是西德和奥地利，属于第一阶段第二组的最后一场比赛；阿尔及利亚和智利已于前一天完成小组赛。由于那场比赛的结果已确定，西德只要以一至两球取胜，西德和奥地利就都能晋级，阿尔及利亚则会被淘汰。此前阿尔及利亚曾在首场比赛中击败西德。

en.s: The UEFA Euro 1988 final was the final match of UEFA Euro 1988, the eighth European Championship, UEFA's top football competition for national teams. en.s: The Rano massacre, also known as the Digos massacre, refers to the aftermath of an incident which occurred in the village of Rano in Barangay Binaton, Digos, Davao del Sur on June 25, 1989 which resulted to the death of 39 people. en.s: The 1989 Soviet Cup Final was a football match that took place at the Lenin's Central Stadium, Moscow on June 25, 1989. The Soviet Cup winner Dnipro qualified for the Champions Cup for winning the champion's title, while the finalist Torpedo was allowed to compete at the Cup Winners' Cup first round for the Soviet Union.

zh.s: 1989年苏联杯决赛于1989年6月25日在莫斯科列宁中央体育场举行，是第48届苏联杯决赛。参赛双方是第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克第聂伯队和莫斯科鱼雷队。苏联杯冠军第聂伯队已凭联赛冠军身份获得欧洲冠军杯参赛资格；决赛另一方莫斯科鱼雷队则获准代表苏联参加欧洲优胜者杯首轮。

en.s: King of the Ring (1995) was the third annual King of the Ring professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF). It took place on June 25, 1995, at the CoreStates Spectrum in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The main event was a tag team match in which WWF Champion Diesel and Bam Bam Bigelow faced Tatanka and Sycho Sid. Diesel won the match by pinning Tatanka. en.s: The Khobar Towers bombing was a terrorist attack on part of a housing complex in the city of Khobar, Saudi Arabia, located near the national oil company (Saudi Aramco) headquarters of Dhahran and nearby King Abdulaziz Air Base on June 25, 1996. At that time, Khobar Towers was being used as quarters for Coalition forces who were assigned to Operation Southern Watch, a no-fly zone operation in southern Iraq, as part of the Iraqi no-fly zones. A truck bomb was detonated adjacent to Building #131, an eight-storey structure housing members of the United States Air Force's 4404th Wing (Provisional), primarily from a deployed rescue squadron and deployed fighter squadron.

zh.s: 1996年6月25日，沙特阿拉伯胡拜尔市的一处住宅区遭到恐怖袭击。胡拜尔塔靠近沙特国家石油公司沙特阿美在宰赫兰的总部和阿卜杜勒阿齐兹国王空军基地，当时用作参加“南方守望行动”的联军部队营房。该行动是在伊拉克南部禁飞区执行的任务。卡车炸弹在131号楼旁引爆。这栋八层建筑住有美国空军临时第4404联队的人员，主要来自部署在当地的救援中队和战斗机中队。

en.s: The Zimbabwe parliamentary elections of 2000 to the Zimbabwe House of Assembly were held on 24 and 25 June 2000. The electoral system involved 120 constituencies returning one member each, elected by the First Past the Post system, with the President of Zimbabwe then nominating 20 members and ten further members from the Tribal Chiefs sitting ex officio. This was the first election in which Robert Mugabe's Zanu-PF party faced any real opposition. The newly formed Movement for Democratic Change challenged Mugabe's control of parliament. The MDC won 57 of the 120 elected seats. Zanu PF won 63 seats.

zh.s: 津巴布韦于2000年6月24日至25日举行国民议会选举。选举采用单议席选区制，120个选区各选出一名议员，津巴布韦总统另行任命20名议员，另有10名部族酋长以当然身份入席。这是罗伯特·穆加贝领导的非洲民族联盟—爱国阵线首次面对真正的反对势力。新成立的争取民主变革运动挑战穆加贝对议会的控制，赢得120个民选席位中的57席；非洲民族联盟—爱国阵线赢得63席。

en.s: King of the Ring (2000) was the eighth annual King of the Ring professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Federation (WWF). The event was presented by Subway and took place on June 25, 2000, at the Fleet Center in Boston, Massachusetts. The main event was a six-man tag team match between McMahon-Helmsley Faction (Triple H, Vince, and Shane McMahon) and the team of The Rock and The Brothers of Destruction (The Undertaker and Kane). Triple H's WWF Championship was defended in the match. Rock pinned Vince to win the title. The undercard featured the 2000 King of the Ring tournament, won by Kurt Angle.

zh.s: 2000年“擂台之王”大赛是世界摔角联盟（WWF）举办的第八届同名付费赛事，由赛百味赞助，于2000年6月25日在波士顿FleetCenter举行。主赛是六人双打赛，麦克马洪—赫尔姆斯利派系（Triple H、文斯·麦克马洪和肖恩·麦克马洪）对阵洛克与毁灭兄弟（送葬者和凯恩）。Triple H的WWF冠军头衔也在比赛中接受挑战，洛克压制文斯并赢得冠军。赛事还包括由科特·安格夺冠的2000年“擂台之王”锦标赛。

en.s: Elections to the Shugi-In (House of Representatives) of the Japanese Diet were held on 25 June 2000. The ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) maintained a majority in the House of Representatives, but its total percentage of seats shrank from 65% to 56%, and its two coalition partners also lost several seats. Two cabinet members, Takashi Fukaya and Tokuichiro Tamazawa, lost their seats.

en.t: United States Senate special election in Massachusetts, 2013
en.s: The 2013 United States Senate special election in Massachusetts was held on June 25, 2013, in order to fill the Massachusetts Class 2 United States Senate seat for the remainder of the term ending January 3, 2015. Incumbent president Alejandro Giammattei was constitutionally prohibited from running for a second four-year term.

zh.s: 危地马拉于2023年6月25日举行大选，选出总统和副总统、国会全部160名议员、中美洲议会全部20名议员，以及全国340个市镇的市长和议会成员。根据宪法，现任总统亚历杭德罗·贾马特泰不能再竞选第二个四年任期。

en.s: Snap parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 25 June 2023. All 300 seats in the Hellenic Parliament were contested. Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis called for the snap vote after the May 2023 elections did not result in any party gaining a majority, although his centre-right New Democracy made unanticipated gains and increased its share of the vote.

zh.s: 希腊于2023年6月25日提前举行议会选举，角逐全部300个议席。2023年5月选举未能使任何政党取得多数席位后，总理基里亚科斯·米佐塔基斯宣布提前投票。尽管他的中右翼新民主党在5月选举中意外增加了得票比例，但仍未取得多数。

en.s: The 2023 Guatemala City mayoral election was held on 25 June 2023, to elect the mayor of Guatemala City, Department of Guatemala and thirteen members of the Municipal Council. Incumbent Ricardo Quiñónez Lemus was eligible for another term. Quiñónez of the Unionist Party ran for re-election with the support of Valor. Juan Francisco Solórzano Foppa, a pre-candidate of the Semilla–Winaq–URNG–MAIZ coalition, was unable to register due to legal issues, but his team was registered.

zh.s: 危地马拉省的危地马拉城于2023年6月25日举行选举，选出市长和市议会13名成员。现任市长里卡多·基尼奥内斯·莱穆斯可以竞选连任。他代表统一党参选，并得到价值党支持。种子—维纳克—URNG—MAIZ联盟预选候选人胡安·弗朗西斯科·索洛萨诺·福帕因法律问题无法登记，但其团队成功登记。

en.s: The 2023 Campeón de Campeones was the 50th edition of the Campeón de Campeones, an annual football super cup match. It took place on 25 June 2023 between Pachuca, the Apertura 2022 champion, and Tigres, the Clausura 2023 champion. The match took place at Dignity Health Sports Park in Carson, California, hosting for the sixth time. Like previous editions, the Campeón de Campeones was contested at a neutral venue in the United States.

zh.s: 2023年“冠军对冠军”超级杯是该年度足球超级杯的第50届赛事，于2023年6月25日举行，由2022年秋季联赛冠军帕丘卡对阵2023年春季联赛冠军老虎队。比赛在美国加利福尼亚州卡森的尊严健康体育公园举行，这是该球场第六次承办该赛事。与往届一样，比赛在美国的中立场地进行。

en.s: The 2024 Colorado's 4th congressional district special election was held on June 25, 2024, to fill the vacant seat in Colorado's 4th congressional district. The winner served in the United States House of Representatives for the remainder of the 118th United States Congress. The seat became vacant on March 22, 2024, when Ken Buck resigned from Congress.

zh.s: 科罗拉多州于2024年6月25日举行第4国会选区特别选举，填补该选区的空缺席位。胜选者担任美国众议员，完成第118届国会剩余任期。肯·巴克于2024年3月22日辞去国会议员职务，因此产生空缺。

en.s: The paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) waged a major offensive against the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) in Sennar State, resulting in widespread violence and displacement, as part of the ongoing Sudanese civil war. On 5 March, SAF launched a counteroffensive on the rest of RSF controlled territory in Sennar, and on the same day recaptured remaining RSF controlled areas located in the state, including Mazmoum and Al-Dali, leading to RSF withdrawal across the South Sudan border.

en.s: Following an attempt to oust the head of the Armenian Apostolic Church, Garegin II by the Armenian government of Nikol Pashinyan, and further opposition reactions, on 25 June 2025, the National Security Service (NSS) announced that it had arrested Archbishop Bagrat Galstanyan, who led the 2024 Armenian protests, and 14 other opposition figures. A few days later, Archbishop Mikael Adjapahyan was also arrested.

zh.s: 尼科尔·帕希尼扬领导的亚美尼亚政府试图罢免亚美尼亚使徒教会领袖卡雷金二世，反对派随后作出回应。2025年6月25日，国家安全局宣布逮捕领导2024年抗议活动的大主教巴格拉特·加尔斯塔尼扬及另外14名反对派人士。几天后，大主教米凯尔·阿贾帕希扬也被捕。
